data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'zosimos' meaning 'life of God'. In the early Christian tradition, Zosimo was the name of several saints. The name Zosimo carries the meaning “Life of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Zosimo usually hope their child will grow to embody life of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Zosimo belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Life of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Zosimo total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
data.cultural_impact: The name Zosimo has a rich cultural significance in the Christian tradition due to its Greek origins. The name has been borne by several saints throughout history, including one of the Seven Sleepers of Ephesus and St. Zosimos the Gaul, who were known for their piety and spiritual devotion. Thus, the name is often associated with Christian spirituality and martyrdom.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Zosimo holds deep spiritual significance as it reminds us of our connection to the divine. The name, which means 'life of God', encourages us to seek a closer relationship with God and to live a life that is reflective of His love and grace. By embracing this name, individuals are called to cultivate a deeper spiritual awareness and to live as a living testimony of God's presence in their lives.
